verdict.rationale: Vendor docs/GitHub claim strong support for describing features/bugs in plain language and having the agent edit/debug across large codebases (gemini-cli-gh-1, gemini-cli-gh-3), but multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict this: users report the agent getting stuck in error loops, failing basic file edit/read operations, ignoring GEMINI.md context files, jumping straight into 'spaghetti code' without a plan mode, and in one case catastrophically deleting user data via botched commands. missing for 10: consistent hands-on success stories on multi-file feature implementation, resolution of the reported reliability/looping failures, and independent benchmarks confirming multi-file bug-fix accuracy.
